title: SAP Fieldglass: Review a Time Sheet
headline:
Review the evidence.
Choose the right action.
audience: Buyer-side managers learning a time-sheet review workflow
need: A reviewer approves a fictional time sheet without comparing it with the supporting work record.
outcomes: Identify a mismatch between a time sheet and a supporting record.
Choose an approval or rejection response with a specific reason.

concepts.title: Know your role and configuration
concepts.body: This lesson is a simplified buyer-review simulation, not a live SAP Fieldglass interface. Menu labels, available actions and approval routing depend on company configuration and your permissions. Use your organization’s procedure for real work.

concepts.title: Review before acting
concepts.body: Check the worker, period, hours or units and relevant work details against the authorized supporting evidence. The comparison checklist in this sample is fictional training guidance, not an SAP-mandated company policy.

concepts.title: Approve or reject with a reason
concepts.body: SAP Fieldglass supports buyer approval or rejection of time and expense sheets. Rejection requires a reason; rejected sheets can be corrected and resubmitted. Use a precise, factual reason so the submitter knows what to fix.

concepts.title: Recognize a different correction path
concepts.body: A sheet already approved and invoiced may need the revised-time-sheet process. Do not treat an invoiced correction as if it were still a pending approval. Available revision options depend on configuration; follow the approved process.

example.title: Fictional record FG-204
example.body: The pending time sheet shows Monday 8, Tuesday 8, Wednesday 8, Thursday 8 and Friday 8 hours: total 40. The authorized work record shows Friday 6 hours and all other days 8: total 38.
steps: Confirm the same worker and week are being compared.
Locate the mismatch: Friday differs by two hours.
Choose Reject in this pending-review simulation.
Reason: Friday shows 8 hours; the supporting record shows 6. Please correct or supply the missing evidence and resubmit.

practice.prompt: Pending sheet: 40 hours. Supporting record: 38, with Friday differing by two. What is the best next action in this case?
options: Approve because the total looks normal
Reject with the Friday discrepancy and a clear correction request
practice.feedback: The evidence does not support approval. A specific reason enables correction without making unrelated changes.

draft.prompt: Write a rejection reason for the Friday mismatch. Include the location, observed difference and requested next step.
draft.label: Your reviewer note
draft.model: For the week on FG-204, Friday lists 8 hours while the supporting record lists 6. Please correct Friday or provide the additional authorized evidence, then resubmit for review.
criteria: Identifies the affected period or record

quiz.prompt: What should you confirm before comparing totals?
options: Only the color of the row
quiz.feedback: A comparison is meaningful only when the records describe the same work.

quiz.prompt: The sheet has a known unsupported two-hour difference. Choose…
options: Approve and hope it is correct
Close the browser and call it approved
quiz.feedback: A documented discrepancy requires resolution in this scenario.

quiz.prompt: Which rejection note is most useful?
options: Friday lists 8; the record lists 6. Correct or provide support, then resubmit.
quiz.feedback: It locates the issue and explains the next action.

quiz.prompt: A sheet is already approved and invoiced. What should you investigate?
options: Whether all companies use identical screens
quiz.feedback: The state of the sheet affects the appropriate correction path.

quiz.prompt: Why might a real user see different actions?
options: The simulation guarantees every tenant is identical
quiz.feedback: Tenant settings and role permissions affect the available workflow.

jobaid: Confirm worker, period and supporting evidence.
Compare hours or units at the detail level.
Resolve mismatches with a precise reason.
Use the correction path appropriate to the sheet’s status.
sources: SAP: Worker Management, processing time and expense sheets
disclosure: Original fictional workplace scenarios. This independent portfolio sample is not official employer or vendor training.
